notes: This paired portable TCK case covers only the timestamp-supplied Send Interaction branch when the interaction class preferred order is RECEIVE. The provider, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation are adapter inputs. No other preferred-order/timestamp-presence combination, remote interoperability, or conformance claim is made.

requirements.statement: When the interaction class preferred order is RECEIVE, the timestamp-supplied Send Interaction service reports the supplied timestamp while the sent and received order metadata are RECEIVE; the service result and callback carry no valid message-retraction designator. The focused observation also confirms the interaction callback precedes the receiver's matching grant.
